Name: Custom Crab Pot
Author: WizVicky
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#00bfff]Custom Crab Pot[/color][/b][/size]
[i]Overhaul your Crab Pots! Catch regular fish and roe, enable auto-baiting, auto-harvest directly into chests, and customize catch qualities using an in-game menu.[/i][/center]

[line]

[size=4][b][color=#4db8ff]Description[/color][/b][/size]
[b]Custom Crab Pot[/b] completely upgrades how crab pots work in Stardew Valley. Whether you want to focus on specific fish, automate your workflow, or harvest high-quality roe directly from the water, this mod gives you the tools to do it.

[i]Say goodbye to junk items and hello to a customized fishing experience![/i]

[line]

[size=4][b][color=#4db8ff] Key Features[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*] [b]Custom Catch Targets:[/b] Choose exactly what your crab pots catch. Stick to traditional trap fish, catch any local river/ocean fish, or use the new feature to harvest [b]fish roe[/b] directly![/*]
[*][b]Auto-Harvest System:[/b] Link your crab pots to a specific chest. Every morning, your daily catches will be automatically deposited.[/*]
[*][b]Auto-Bait System:[/b] Automatically refill empty crab pots with your preferred bait (Includes a "cheat" option for free bait).[/*]
[*][b]Quality & Bonus Control:[/b] Adjust the percentage chances of catching [color=#9900ff][b]Iridium[/b][/color], [color=#ffd700][b]Gold[/b][/color], or [color=#b6b6b6][b]Silver[/b][/color] quality items.[/*]
[*][b]Full GMCM Integration:[/b] Fully compatible with Generic Mod Config Menu. Adjust everything in real-time without ever touching a config file![/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][b][color=#4db8ff]Changelog / Update Log[/color][/b][/size]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*] [b]UI & Settings Upgrade:[/b] Added new X and Y position settings to the GMCM. Move the Crab Pot Count and Chest Location UI overlays anywhere on your screen![/*]
[*][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed "Mixed" setting bug where it only generated roe. Now perfectly balances live animals and flavored roe (50/50 chance).[/*]
[*][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed roe naming and UI alert bugs.[/*]
[*][b]System Improvement:[/b] Completely reworked core catching logic for the "Fish & Roe" system for better balance. [/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[line]

[size=4][b][color=#4db8ff]Requirements[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400][b]SMAPI[/b][/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b][/url][/*]
[/list]
[line]

Downloads.Description: fixes to the Fish & Roe system ensuring a perfect 50/50 catch balance, fixes roe stacking bugs, and introduces fully customizable X/Y positioning for the UI overlays via GMCM!
